note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 9568 Section 7.1 says "It MUST verify that the VRID is configured on the receiving interface." TestDecodeGoldenV3IPv4 now decodes the RFC 9568 message-only golden G2 under the default-mode lookup instead of the pseudo-header golden G2c, and lost only the removed MsgOnlyChecksum assertion; the subtests of TestNegativeReferenceBugs other than N1 gained only the FillChecksum mode argument. The positive is still a fully conforming advert, the checksum check precedes the checks this row names so a wrong form would fail with ErrChecksum and not pass silently, and each negative still asserts its exact sentinel. TestRxAdvertScopedToReceivingInterface changed only by the checksum-mode plumbing (a Checksum: packet.ChecksumRFC9568 field added to the GroupSpec, AdvertParams or packet.Local literal, or the mode argument added to packet.FillChecksum); every assertion and every isolating input is byte-for-byte the same. TestRxV3VRIDCheckedOnTheReceivingInterface, unchanged, still discards VRID 10 received on the VRID-20 interface with exactly [vrid]. Verdict unchanged.
